title: Builder BLD-202: Add by intent

source.ref: Owner approval 2026-11-02: build the next-gen builder from the role and block contracts. BLD-202.

detail:
B2 Roles, pass BLD-202 (spec: docs/EDITOR-NEXT.md#bld-202). Add by intent. Scope: components/builder/add. Build: + opens 'What should this part do?' with the intents, grouped (21 roles in builder v3). Previews render each role's default variant with the Space's own data where role.data is set, else the flagged sample. Insert at the chosen index; select it; one undo step. Done when: Only roles legal for the current kind and surface are offered; Preview uses Space data when present. Gates: vitest suite (required test job), check:theme-conformance, a11y ratchet, Pass probes, check:backlog, check:one-list, check:adr, check:id-collisions. After: BLD-201, BLD-103. Loop: build, validate, repair (3 cycles, classes in EDITOR-NEXT.md), record.

The canvas +, the outline's + and the phone's Add button (and Add a section in the command bar) open 'What should this part do?': up to three suggestions this page lacks, then the roles by intent under Welcome, Show up, Trust, Answer and More, with a search. What is offered is what is legal: the website palette for this theme (derivePickerGroups), the builder's surface (a role whose email form is hide is not offered on email) and the per-page caps (disabled with the reason). The focused card's preview draws the role's default variant on this page's canvas; rolePreviewMetadata keeps the Space's own rows when the role is live and has some, else drops the Space so the sample draws. Insert lands where the + was, selects the new section and is one undo step. Each role file gained a one-line why for its card (check:roles requires it). Render: scripts/render/builder-add-sheet.render.tsx.
